verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Pipedream offers interactive ways to try its tools: a hosted chat app at chat.pipedream.com and a "Try the MCP demo" link. Its docs also include static code snippets for connecting to the remote server, and it provides a REST API with SDKs. None of this is shown to be an interactive API reference with runnable, in-page examples; it is a demo chat plus static docs. Missing for 10: a documented interactive API reference or API explorer, runnable examples embedded in the reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
